# Concentrated Fire Perk Card

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 13, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Sep 4, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0a6ef634bc27498085a87b7a8426b6b1~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Concentrated Fire__

*****As of PTS August 2025*****

**SPECIAL:** 

Perception

**New Perk Card Description:** 

- This perk no longer grants limb targeting.
- Limb targeting in V.A.T.S. now activates automatically when your Perception reaches 5 or higher.
- Concentrated Fire builds up a bonus each time you target the same limb in V.A.T.S., stacking up to a maximum of 20 times.
- You do not need to hit the target — simply aiming at the same limb is enough to build the bonus.
- There is no HUD indicator showing how many stacks you have.
- The bonus resets if you exit V.A.T.S. or switch to a different limb.

Classified as non-automatic weapons, Crossbows, Compound Bows, and Recurve Bows all benefit from this perk card.

**Rank 1 Concentrated Fire** 

- +1% damage per stack
- +4% accuracy per stack (Non-Automatic Weapons)
- +1% accuracy per stack (Automatic Weapons)

**Rank 2 Concentrated Fire** 

- +2% damage per stack
- +8% accuracy per stack (Non-Automatic Weapons)
- +2% accuracy per stack (Automatic Weapons)

**Rank 3 Concentrated Fire** 

- +3% damage per stack
- +12% accuracy per stack (Non-Automatic Weapons)
- +3% accuracy per stack (Automatic Weapons)

**Image of updated perk card:** 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9460022833d646fab6af875f21ec2bd6~mv2.jpg)

__How to Use This Calculator__

**Step 1:**

Select your Concentrated Fire perk rank (1, 2, or 3) based on the rank of the card you have equipped.

**Step 2:**

Choose your weapon type:

- Non-Automatic
- Automatic

**Step 3:**

Pick how many shots at the same limb you expect to take (1–20).

- Boss fights or long V.A.T.S. chains may reach 20 stacks.
- Regular enemies usually only last 3–6 stacks.

Then click Calculate to see your total damage bonus and accuracy boost based on your chosen perk rank, weapon type, and number of stacks.

**Note:**

This calculator provides an estimate only. Actual in-game damage can vary based on enemy resistances, critical hits, limb targeting, buffs, debuffs, and other modifiers.
